title: townsendia alpigena var. caelilinensis
intro: Townsendia alpigena var. caelilinensis, commonly known as alpine Townsendia, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is a perennial herb that is native to the western United States, and is known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Townsendia alpigena var. caelilinensis include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
